description: This file defines a Java class 'MonkeyLogParser' responsible for parsing monkey log files, extracting ANR (Application Not Responding) events, and updating bug report data structures accordingly.

classes.name: MonkeyLogParser
classes.description: A parser class for analyzing monkey log files to detect ANRs and handle related data extraction.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the provided bug report and lines from a monkey log to identify and process ANR events.

methods.name: extractAnrLines
methods.description: Extracts lines corresponding to ANR events from the monkey log, using pattern matching to detect start and end points.
